strategies.name: Equal-weight universe (buy-and-hold proxy)
strategies.description: All liquid stocks in the app's 105-name universe, equal weights, rebalanced every 20 trading days. Includes dividends (adjusted prices) and costs.

strategies.name: KSE-100 index (price, no dividends)
strategies.description: The KSE-100 index itself, no costs. A price index: it excludes dividends, which the strategies earn.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 10, rebalance 5d
strategies.description: Hold the top 10 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 5 trading days.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 10, rebalance 5d, buffer
strategies.description: Hold the top 10 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 5 trading days; keep a holding while it stays in the top 20.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 20, rebalance 5d
strategies.description: Hold the top 20 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 5 trading days.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 20, rebalance 5d, buffer
strategies.description: Hold the top 20 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 5 trading days; keep a holding while it stays in the top 40.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 10, rebalance 20d
strategies.description: Hold the top 10 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 20 trading days.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 10, rebalance 20d, buffer
strategies.description: Hold the top 10 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 20 trading days; keep a holding while it stays in the top 20.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 20, rebalance 20d
strategies.description: Hold the top 20 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 20 trading days.

strategies.name: Factor rank: top 20, rebalance 20d, buffer
strategies.description: Hold the top 20 liquid stocks by a fixed blend of 6-month momentum (skipping the last month), closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility; rebalance every 20 trading days; keep a holding while it stays in the top 40.

strategies.name: Single factor: mom_120_20, top 20, 20d, buffer
strategies.description: Same as the factor blend but ranking on mom_120_20 alone.

strategies.name: Single factor: dist_high_250, top 20, 20d, buffer
strategies.description: Same as the factor blend but ranking on dist_high_250 alone.

strategies.name: Single factor: lowvol_60, top 20, 20d, buffer
strategies.description: Same as the factor blend but ranking on lowvol_60 alone.

strategies.name: Factor rank (primary) on point-in-time universe
strategies.description: The primary factor strategy (top 20, 20d, buffer) on a universe rebuilt each month from the 100 most traded stocks at that time, including names later delisted. Checks survivorship bias.

strategies.name: ML rank (LightGBM): top 10, 5d horizon
strategies.description: One LightGBM model across all stocks predicts each stock's 5-day return relative to the others from ranked price/volume features; hold the top 10, rebalance every 5 days, keep holdings in the top 20.

strategies.name: ML rank (LightGBM): top 20, 5d horizon
strategies.description: One LightGBM model across all stocks predicts each stock's 5-day return relative to the others from ranked price/volume features; hold the top 20, rebalance every 5 days, keep holdings in the top 40.

strategies.name: ML rank (LightGBM): top 10, 20d horizon
strategies.description: One LightGBM model across all stocks predicts each stock's 20-day return relative to the others from ranked price/volume features; hold the top 10, rebalance every 20 days, keep holdings in the top 20.

strategies.name: ML rank (LightGBM): top 20, 20d horizon
strategies.description: One LightGBM model across all stocks predicts each stock's 20-day return relative to the others from ranked price/volume features; hold the top 20, rebalance every 20 days, keep holdings in the top 40.

strategies.name: factor + market filter (0% when KSE-100 < 200d avg)
strategies.description: The factor strategy (top 20, 20d), but exposure drops to 0% while the KSE-100 is below its 200-day average.

strategies.name: factor + market filter (50% when KSE-100 < 200d avg)
strategies.description: The factor strategy (top 20, 20d), but exposure drops to 50% while the KSE-100 is below its 200-day average.

strategies.name: factor + inverse-volatility weights
strategies.description: The factor strategy (top 20, 20d) with position sizes inversely proportional to 60-day volatility.

strategies.name: ML rank + market filter (0% when KSE-100 < 200d avg)
strategies.description: The ML rank strategy (top 20, 20d), but exposure drops to 0% while the KSE-100 is below its 200-day average.

strategies.name: ML rank + market filter (50% when KSE-100 < 200d avg)
strategies.description: The ML rank strategy (top 20, 20d), but exposure drops to 50% while the KSE-100 is below its 200-day average.

strategies.name: ML rank + inverse-volatility weights
strategies.description: The ML rank strategy (top 20, 20d) with position sizes inversely proportional to 60-day volatility.

strategies.name: Direction model, confident only (p>0.55), 5d
strategies.description: A LightGBM classifier across all stocks estimates the probability each stock rises over 5 days; buy up to 10 stocks (10% each) whose probability exceeds 0.55, otherwise hold cash.

strategies.name: Direction model, confident only (p>0.60), 5d
strategies.description: A LightGBM classifier across all stocks estimates the probability each stock rises over 5 days; buy up to 10 stocks (10% each) whose probability exceeds 0.60, otherwise hold cash.

strategies.name: Direction model, confident only (p>0.55), 20d
strategies.description: A LightGBM classifier across all stocks estimates the probability each stock rises over 20 days; buy up to 10 stocks (10% each) whose probability exceeds 0.55, otherwise hold cash.

strategies.name: Direction model, confident only (p>0.60), 20d
strategies.description: A LightGBM classifier across all stocks estimates the probability each stock rises over 20 days; buy up to 10 stocks (10% each) whose probability exceeds 0.60, otherwise hold cash.

strategies.name: Buy and hold PSO
strategies.description: Buy PSO once and hold it (dividends included).

strategies.name: Persistence PSO (long after an up day)
strategies.description: Hold PSO the day after it rose, cash after it fell. Naive baseline for the daily models.

strategies.name: Current PSO model, trade every signal
strategies.description: The app's PSO model (xgboost, same settings and features), refit quarterly on data available at the time, predicting the next tradable day. Hold PSO when it predicts a rise, cash otherwise.

strategies.name: Current PSO model, confident signals only
strategies.description: As above, but only act when the predicted rise is in the top third of the model's recent predictions; otherwise cash.

strategies.name: Buy and hold MEBL
strategies.description: Buy MEBL once and hold it (dividends included).

strategies.name: Persistence MEBL (long after an up day)
strategies.description: Hold MEBL the day after it rose, cash after it fell. Naive baseline for the daily models.

strategies.name: Current MEBL model, trade every signal
strategies.description: The app's MEBL model (lightgbm, same settings and features), refit quarterly on data available at the time, predicting the next tradable day. Hold MEBL when it predicts a rise, cash otherwise.

strategies.name: Current MEBL model, confident signals only
strategies.description: As above, but only act when the predicted rise is in the top third of the model's recent predictions; otherwise cash.

strategies.name: Random picks, same turnover (median of 20)
strategies.description: Random liquid stocks, replacing as many names at each rebalance as the primary factor strategy does. Dev-period CAGR across 20 seeds: median 12.7%, 95th percentile 15.5%.
